_stalierino_: Ulrich Stalierino came from Rosenau, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

Ulrich Stalierino was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at P-F9. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Walter "Spark" Cthulhu of the Concord (@cthulhu1703). News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Ulrich Stalierino during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A bullet struck Ulrich Stalierino below the ribs at P-F9. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Bram "Button" Nailonailon of the Concord (@nailonailon). Ulrich Stalierino was hit at P-F9 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Bram "Button" Nailonailon of the Concord (@nailonailon).
The papers connected Pavel Stalierino to Ulrich Stalierino. The men took longer to learn Pavel Stalierino's own habits, but they made the effort.
Pavel Stalierino thought about a teacher who said he would amount to nothing on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
Pavel Stalierino and Tobias Lilmaggs split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
Pavel Stalierino found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.

Pavel Stalierino was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at P-F9. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Lucien "Brick" Yuas of the Concord (@krauser.yuas). Pavel Stalierino was killed on watch at P-F9. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Lucien "Brick" Yuas of the Concord (@krauser.yuas).
Isidor Stalierino came to the front because his father Pavel Stalierino never came home. He carries a lock of hair in a matchbox.
bigmanreen: On Day 13 Matthias "Smokes" Bigmanreen took a post at N-F8 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He keeps feeding the rats, and the men liked him for it.
Matthias "Smokes" Bigmanreen carried Ivo "Shadow" Chenier's rifle all the way up to the Ossuary Wood after Shadow twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to.

A single shot from across the wire hit Matthias "Smokes" Bigmanreen in the thigh at N-F8. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Severin Foolio of the Concord (@don_foolio_1). Matthias "Smokes" Bigmanreen looked over the parapet at N-F8 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Severin Foolio of the Concord (@don_foolio_1).
A letter came with Ulrich "Hollow" Bigmanreen: "I am Matthias "Smokes" Bigmanreen's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Rain all night. Ulrich "Hollow" Bigmanreen bailed water out of N-F8 with a helmet until his hands stopped feeling anything.
car_deeznut: Day 9. The corporal put Jakub Deeznut beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Konrad "Ash" Sapino, grazed. Jakub Deeznut cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Jakub Deeznut read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Behind the lines Jakub Deeznut had a bath in a beer vat with eleven other men. The water was brown before he got in. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Jakub Deeznut answered to number 802. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-R9. Jakub Deeznut has learned to walk bent double.
A bullet grazed Jakub Deeznut's ribs at S-R9. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Nils Toro of the Hegemony (@fidel_del_toro).
The medics cleaned Jakub Deeznut's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-R9.
Jakub Deeznut and Nils Jacobflamber both swear they saw a ghost at the Bone Quarry. Each says the other screamed first.
Jakub Deeznut tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.

Fresh from training, Jakub Deeznut still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Norbert Fransinlak, badly wounded. Jakub Deeznut fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Albin Theelliottma was badly wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.
d3ik0s: The draft reached R-R5 on Day 9. Nils Diks was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Nils Diks stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A bullet went through Nils Diks's upper arm at R-R5 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Gustav Filipentav of the Hegemony (@filipentav). Nils Diks was killed outright at R-R5, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Gustav Filipentav of the Hegemony (@filipentav).

Dietrich Diks put a frozen apple beside the bunk. Someone who had known Nils Diks helped clear the shelf without saying why. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Dietrich Diks is number 900. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-R5. Dietrich Diks has learned to walk bent double.

Dietrich Diks was hit twice at R-R5, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Tobias Flyer of the Hegemony (@caboose_flyer1280102938392). The bearers reached Dietrich Diks at R-R5 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Tobias Flyer of the Hegemony (@caboose_flyer1280102938392).
Felix "Button" Diks had heard about Dietrich Diks's courage. At R-R5, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
A note came over the wire at Sorrow Copse, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Felix "Mud" Goat.' Felix "Button" Diks sang louder.
A grenade fragment found Felix "Button" Diks's shoulder. He calls it a souvenir and refuses to be sent back.
Felix "Button" Diks walked back up the communication trench to R-R5, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Felix "Button" Diks and Felix Bubik spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
david2449_: On the way to R-C15, Ivo "Bones" David tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Ivo "Bones" David had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Cyril Zgeorges was badly wounded. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Ivo "Bones" David read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Ivo "Bones" David fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Severin Lagbagdotzip was grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Ivo "Bones" David is number 693 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Ivo "Bones" David stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Ivo "Bones" David and Quentin Cade carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Ivo "Bones" David fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Severin Lagbagdotzip did not get to reply at all, badly wounded.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Ivo "Bones" David fired, and Silas Haydengonzal was grazed.
Ivo "Bones" David had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Arno "Hollow" Trout was grazed.
Ivo "Bones" David fired at a movement across the wire at R-C15. The man went down: Viktor Lagbagdotzip, grazed.
dawkins.ennisjr: Teodor Ennisjr introduced himself as a dance-hall violinist from Rosenau. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

The whole squad at U-F11 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Teodor Ennisjr's bullet that found Felix "Lucky" Calmherculie, gravely wounded. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Teodor Ennisjr read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Teodor Ennisjr and Hugo Pencil carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Teodor Ennisjr. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Teodor Ennisjr. The men named it Inkwell and said it had chosen him.
A crow sat on the parapet above Teodor Ennisjr all afternoon. The men say it chose him.
Inkwell the crow follows Teodor Ennisjr along the trench now. When Inkwell flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.
diboo_007y8: Quentin "Hollow" Diboo told the sergeant he was a clockmaker. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Quentin "Hollow" Diboo kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A bullet grazed Quentin "Hollow" Diboo's ribs at S-C7. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Jakub Aklouisza of the Hegemony (@aklouisza). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Quentin "Hollow" Diboo answered to number 666. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Quentin "Hollow" Diboo read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The medic looked at Quentin "Hollow" Diboo's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-C7. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Quentin "Hollow" Diboo counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
At Hill 304, Quentin "Hollow" Diboo and Casimir Dunkmyanactu exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.

Quentin "Hollow" Diboo fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Felix Jakub, grazed. Quentin "Hollow" Diboo felt a hard tug at his hip at S-C7. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Jakub Aklouisza of the Hegemony (@aklouisza).
Quentin "Hollow" Diboo came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
dooficus: Konrad Dooficus came up on Day 13 carrying news from Saint-Lune. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Walter Jackiv saved the last of the sugar for Konrad Dooficus's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Konrad's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
Konrad Dooficus and Konrad Function sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.

Konrad Dooficus went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Hegemony trench Quentin "Whistle" Bezuidenhout put up a fight, but not for long. (@bezuidenhoutzander0) The Hegemony sentry, Valentin "Spark" Waxy, shouted once. Konrad Dooficus silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@waxy4422) The raid was over in minutes. On the way back a machine gun swept no man's land, and Konrad Dooficus did not reach the parapet.
Ivo Dooficus joined N-F2 under the shadow of Konrad Dooficus's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
egg_mongus_48: Bastian Mongus arrived on Day 14 as a replacement. The men in V-F20 had been fighting for 14 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Bastian Mongus was hit in the hip at V-F20. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Clement "Mole" Ikaikaism of the Concord (@ikaikaism). Bastian Mongus was hit at V-F20 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Clement "Mole" Ikaikaism of the Concord (@ikaikaism).
The House of Mongus sent Jakub "Shadow" Mongus after Bastian Mongus. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

Jakub "Shadow" Mongus carried hot tea up to the front line in petrol cans. Everyone could taste the petrol. Everyone drank it. A letter reached Jakub "Shadow" Mongus in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.
hartilllondon: Emil Hartilllondo signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at Q-S10 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Emil Hartilllondo read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Emil Hartilllondo of the Concord and Zeno "Hollow" Gsingeis of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Chalk Pits for a week. Both trenches keep score. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Emil Hartilllondo looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Emil Hartilllondo and Lucien "Ghost" Vikt carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Emil Hartilllondo brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
Emil Hartilllondo drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
Emil Hartilllondo flashed a lamp signal to the battery behind the ridge. The answer came back: a single word, misspelled.
Emil Hartilllondo cut Albin Ikanbili's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
helpmed0g: Valentin Helpmed joined the replacements on Day 4. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Valentin Helpmed cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt. A letter from home found Valentin Helpmed before the night shift. Valentin Helpmed folded it small and kept it close. Valentin Helpmed left the work of a rifleman to become a stretcher bearer. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

A shell landed close to S-F21. When the dust settled Valentin Helpmed was still there, holding his mother's thimble, laughing without sound. A letter from home found Valentin Helpmed before the night shift. Valentin Helpmed folded it small and kept it close. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Valentin Helpmed watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
A bullet went through Valentin Helpmed's sleeve at S-F21 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Tobias Lakam of the Concord (@kil.lakam20).
Valentin Helpmed's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Valentin Helpmed has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
On sentry duty Valentin Helpmed watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
Valentin Helpmed walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Valentin Helpmed took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Valentin Helpmed answered to number 298. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Valentin Helpmed could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Valentin Helpmed and Walter Juizy both swear they saw a ghost at the Brickworks. Each says the other screamed first.
Ulrich "Lucky" Robertoneill snores. Valentin Helpmed does not. Valentin now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
Valentin Helpmed found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
A patient apologized for bleeding on Valentin Helpmed's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake.
Valentin Helpmed saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.
its.arthur_f2a: Dietrich "Parson" Arthur signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at P-F13 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Dietrich "Parson" Arthur felt a hard tug at his hip at P-F13. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Teodor Timmy of the Concord (@timmy7jc). Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Dietrich "Parson" Arthur shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Dietrich "Parson" Arthur returned to P-F13 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Dietrich "Parson" Arthur found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
Wind kept turning the pages of Dietrich "Parson" Arthur's letter. He held them down with a biscuit and finished with crumbs in the ink.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Jakub "Brick" Jimbob, badly wounded. Dietrich "Parson" Arthur cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. A bullet hit the sandbag next to Dietrich "Parson" Arthur's ear at P-F13 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Oskar Ohl of the Concord (@mika__ohl).
Fever took hold of Dietrich "Parson" Arthur overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers.
josh.helton0301: In Varenne, Casimir Helton was a clockmaker. In V-F3, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a clockmaker again.

Casimir Helton kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it. A letter from home reached Casimir Helton before dusk. Casimir Helton read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir Helton went out with the wiring party at P-F17. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A letter from home reached Casimir Helton before dusk. Casimir Helton read it twice and slept a little easier.
Casimir Helton lent Karel "Saint" Zebra a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.

Casimir Helton threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Hugo Kiez was down and screaming for a medic. (@cloo.kiez) The Hegemony sentry, Yann "Ash" Max, shouted once. Casimir Helton silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@heger_max) Machine-gun fire swept V-F3. Casimir Helton took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Jakub "Rabbit" Gib of the Hegemony (@c._.gib). Casimir Helton was killed at V-F3 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Jakub "Rabbit" Gib of the Hegemony (@c._.gib).
Otto Helton asked about Casimir Helton on arriving at V-F3. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
kalamitous_kyamites: The draft reached P-F4 on Day 10. Oskar Kyamites was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Oskar Kyamites went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. A letter from home reached Oskar Kyamites before dusk. Oskar Kyamites read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Oskar Kyamites kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Oskar Kyamites tried to describe the smell of Ashford Vale and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived. A letter from home reached Oskar Kyamites before dusk. Oskar Kyamites read it twice and slept a little easier. After what happened at the Sunken Road, Oskar Kyamites asked to serve as a machine gunner. Nobody argued.

Oskar Kyamites fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Konrad Earn was badly wounded. Oskar Kyamites ate breakfast without a word. A letter from home reached Oskar Kyamites before dusk. Oskar Kyamites read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Oskar Kyamites felt a hard tug at his hip at P-F4. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. A letter from home reached Oskar Kyamites before dusk. Oskar Kyamites read it twice and slept a little easier.

Three days with a bandage, and Oskar Kyamites is back at P-F4. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. A letter from home reached Oskar Kyamites before dusk. Oskar Kyamites read it twice and slept a little easier.

Oskar Kyamites was on the dawn watch at P-F4 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Oskar Kyamites was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Matthias Fejobo of the Hegemony (@fejobo). The Hegemony sentry, Konrad "Owl" Brockolili, shouted once. Oskar Kyamites silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@brockolili) Oskar Kyamites went over with the night raiders and never came back. The flare caught Oskar Kyamites on the wire, halfway home. Killed in the night raid by Silas Earn of the Hegemony (@earn_e).
The House of Kyamites sent another. Tobias Kyamites, father of Oskar Kyamites, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
leo.glc: Isidor Glc told the sergeant he was a postman. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.
Volunteer number 61. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Isidor Glc's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
Isidor Glc fired at a movement across the wire at S-F13. The man went down: Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta, grazed.
Rafael "Button" Superfeisty and Isidor Glc made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it with frozen hands.
Isidor Glc carried three men out of S-F13 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Isidor Glc let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Isidor Glc and Quentin Adams tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
The men have learned that Isidor Glc counts everything: steps, shells, stars. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.

Isidor Glc drew the street leading to Millbank. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over. A letter from home found Isidor Glc before the night shift. Isidor Glc folded it small and kept it close. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Isidor Glc looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Isidor Glc closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
A supply man offered Isidor Glc a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.

Isidor Glc put a flat stone under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal. A letter from home found Isidor Glc before the night shift. Isidor Glc folded it small and kept it close.
During a lull at Calvary Farm, Isidor Glc called across from the Concord line. Clement "Saint" Jozsef answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.

Isidor Glc jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Felix Varsikasikra. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@varsikasikranaatti) No rifles, only shovels and knives. Isidor Glc dropped into the Hegemony trench by a dugout door and met Felix Serreno coming out. It was over in seconds. (@anabelen.serreno) The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-F13. Isidor Glc has learned to walk bent double. A letter from home found Isidor Glc before the night shift. Isidor Glc folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet went through Isidor Glc's upper arm at S-F13 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous of the Hegemony (@krokous21). A letter from home found Isidor Glc before the night shift. Isidor Glc folded it small and kept it close. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Isidor Glc wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

The wound looked small. It was not. Isidor Glc was carried back with a fever and a hand that would not stop shaking. Clean sheets, a lamp, and a surgeon. Isidor Glc was admitted to the hospital dugout and finally let go of his rifle. A letter from home found Isidor Glc before the night shift. Isidor Glc folded it small and kept it close.
Isidor Glc's fever broke in the night. The orderly checked the chart twice and smiled for the first time in a week.
Isidor Glc never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.

Isidor Glc coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a march played slightly too slowly, but something knocks once every revolution. A letter from home found Isidor Glc before the night shift. Isidor Glc folded it small and kept it close.
The gramophone stopped knocking after Isidor Glc tightened a screw. The dugout applauded the repair halfway through a march played slightly too slowly, spoiling the best part.
n.nayam2: The new sniper is Emil Nayam, once a farmhand from Lindenbruck. The corporal asked if a farmhand was any use in a trench. Emil Nayam said he would find out.
Emil Nayam moved his hide three times today. Snipers who stay in one place do not stay anywhere for long.

The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Emil Nayam looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Nayam. Emil Nayam read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Emil Nayam waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Lucien Zag did, and was grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Emil Nayam is number 581 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-S1 with the rations. Emil Nayam ate while listening to the revised orders.
Emil Nayam pulled Clement Ther out of a flooded shell hole at the Drowned Farm. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
A beetle crawled across Emil Nayam's sleeve during the long wait. He could do nothing about it without giving away the position.
There is a sniper across the way the men call Grey Hat. Three helmets went up on sticks today. Grey Hat hit all three. Emil Nayam watched where the shots came from.
Emil Nayam read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.

Emil Nayam let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb was gravely wounded. A bullet went through Emil Nayam's sleeve at S-S1 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Leopold Shallowcrow of the Hegemony (@shallowcrow114).
olie300: Arno Olie introduced himself as a bookbinder from Ashford Vale. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Edmund Callmequeeno and Arno Olie sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At relief, the next watch was told it had been a good hour.

Arno Olie heard a man laugh beyond the enemy parapet. The sound was ordinary enough to be more unsettling than a shot. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Arno Olie shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Arno Olie found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores.

Arno Olie read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing. A letter from home reached Arno Olie before dusk. Arno Olie read it twice and slept a little easier.

Arno Olie fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Arno Olie wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
The stores supplied Arno Olie with shorter boards than requested. The gun shelter has become an exercise in joints and bad language.
A single shot from across the wire hit Arno Olie in the thigh at S-F16. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper of the Hegemony (@josiascouper).
Clean sheets, a lamp, and a surgeon. Arno Olie was admitted to the hospital dugout and finally let go of his rifle.
An orderly read the newspaper aloud in the ward. Arno Olie fell asleep halfway through the war news, which was the point.

The field hospital let Arno Olie go. He came back up the line on foot because the truck would not wait. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Arno Olie kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Arno Olie had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Valentin Thky, badly wounded. Arno Olie got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 151. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Arno Olie stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Arno Olie had just lit a cigarette at S-F16 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Hugo Mrcakerson of the Hegemony (@mrcakerson). Arno Olie fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Severin Lilneftrappi was badly wounded. Arno Olie ate breakfast without a word. A letter from home reached Arno Olie before dusk. Arno Olie read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bullet went into Arno Olie's chest just under the heart at S-F16. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper of the Hegemony (@josiascouper). A single shot at S-F16. Arno Olie sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper of the Hegemony (@josiascouper).
Marek Olie came to the front because his father Arno Olie never came home. He carries a book with the last pages torn out.
Marek Olie raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F16. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Dietrich "Spark" Geddy of the Hegemony (@geddy__97).

Marek Olie no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home reached Marek Olie before dusk. Marek Olie read it twice and slept a little easier. After what happened at the Brickworks, Marek Olie asked to serve as a sapper. Nobody argued.

The dugout roof dripped into Marek Olie's mug. He moved the mug. The roof found another way. Marek Olie found a letter on the fire step, left by the runner. Marek Olie read it while the kettle boiled.
reider9921: Pavel Reider came up on Day 6 carrying news from Tannenfeld. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Pavel Reider began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.

A grenade burst short of the parapet at R-S12. Pavel Reider took a splinter in the hand and was bandaged where he stood. Mail came up the line with a letter for Pavel Reider. Pavel Reider read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Pavel Reider came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. Mail came up the line with a letter for Pavel Reider. Pavel Reider read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Pavel Reider aimed a step ahead and fired: Zeno Kallenfultz, grazed. Pavel Reider raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-S12. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Isidor Akkugrg of the Concord (@akkugrg2012). News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Pavel Reider during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Pavel Reider walked back up the communication trench to R-S12, slower than before, but on his own feet. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Pavel Reider answered to number 438. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Pavel Reider wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
The reply to Pavel Reider's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.
The gun crews at R-S12 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Henrik "Brick" Coreyxpainte was badly wounded.
Pavel Reider found an old map of Hill 304 from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them.
Pavel Reider fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at R-S12. Before dawn Zeno Kallenfultz walked into it, grazed.

A single shot from across the wire hit Pavel Reider in the thigh at R-S12. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Norbert "Mole" Yanis of the Concord (@yanis_ey522). Pavel Reider was laid on a stretcher at the end of a long row outside the aid post. The bearers chalked a number on his boot.
shadowwraithgames: The old hands of P-F17 have been here since Day 1. Clement "Rabbit" Shadowwraith has been here since Day 10. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Clement "Rabbit" Shadowwraith began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In P-F17, Clement "Rabbit" Shadowwraith listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Clement "Rabbit" Shadowwraith was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at P-F17. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Quentin Andrew of the Hegemony (@andrew_op56). Clement "Rabbit" Shadowwraith looked over the parapet at P-F17 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Quentin Andrew of the Hegemony (@andrew_op56).
Ulrich Shadowwraith put a frozen apple beside the bunk. Someone who had known Clement "Rabbit" Shadowwraith helped clear the shelf without saying why.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Ulrich Shadowwraith closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Someone asked Ulrich Shadowwraith to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Ulrich Shadowwraith helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.
Ulrich Shadowwraith owes Isidor Nickolaskech so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
sonkeixrp_: Nobody saw Karel Sonkeixrp arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in T-S7, and a quiet signaller under it.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Karel Sonkeixrp stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Karel Sonkeixrp found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Karel Sonkeixrp watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Karel Sonkeixrp and Dorian Wellington carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Karel Sonkeixrp's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Karel Sonkeixrp was hit in the hip at T-S7. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic.
Karel Sonkeixrp drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
Karel Sonkeixrp did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
The papers say Marek Sonkeixrp. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Karel Sonkeixrp's eyes. Nobody in T-S7 argues.
thomasvordermann: Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder walked into R-C14 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

Two men fed the belt while Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Silas Sleepyman was grazed. Blackwater Canal has been won. Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

A bullet went through Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder's sleeve at R-C14 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Marek Marks of the Concord (@marks89kk). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder is number 916. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Victory at Grey Mill. Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
The medic looked at Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-C14. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Henrik Sleepyman was grazed.

Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder swept the enemy parapet at R-C14 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Isidor Jro was grazed. Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-C14. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Florian Marks of the Concord (@marks89kk).
Ulrich "Crow" Thomasvorder walked back up the communication trench to R-C14, slower than before, but on his own feet.
vin.can.do: The sergeant gave Oskar Can a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F21 with the rations. Oskar Can ate while listening to the revised orders.

Oskar Can laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago. Grey Mill is lost. Oskar Can heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Oskar Can borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
A recruit asked Oskar Can how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
Oskar Can and the recruit have reached whole words. Lessons take place beside the stove, with spelling corrections from people pretending not to listen.

A bullet went through Oskar Can's upper arm at T-F21 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Jakub "Spark" Reikland of the Hegemony (@the_knight_of_reikland). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Oskar Can fell at T-F21 and never moved again. Shot by Jakub "Spark" Reikland of the Hegemony (@the_knight_of_reikland).
The papers connected Florian Can to Oskar Can. The men took longer to learn Florian Can's own habits, but they made the effort.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Florian Can aimed a step ahead and fired: Anselm "Rabbit" Zxburg, badly wounded.
zanetaylor_8: Quentin Zanetaylor was a coal miner in Marrow Fen until the posters went up. He came to R-S8 with a tin of tobacco, and within a day the whole squad knew that he counts everything: steps, shells, stars.

Quentin Zanetaylor was peppered by shell splinters at R-S8. A medic picked them out one by one while the next salvo came in. Hill 304 has been won. Quentin Zanetaylor listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Quentin Zanetaylor is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Quentin Zanetaylor and Cyril "Crow" Trevor divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
Quentin Zanetaylor wrote to an old father who runs the family shop alone. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.

Quentin Zanetaylor tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread. A letter from home found Quentin Zanetaylor before the night shift. Quentin Zanetaylor folded it small and kept it close.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-S8 changed before the cheering ended. Quentin Zanetaylor shouldered another load.

A replacement turned out to be from Marrow Fen too. Quentin Zanetaylor and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Quentin Zanetaylor is number 356. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Quentin Zanetaylor shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Quentin Zanetaylor spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.
Two carrying parties met in the narrow trench. Quentin Zanetaylor helped work out how an ammunition box and a very large kettle could pass each other.
A round went through the rim of Quentin Zanetaylor's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Valentin "Button" Boi of the Concord (@gremlin_boi32).

A bullet went through Quentin Zanetaylor's upper arm at R-S8 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Gustav "Mud" Stefano of the Concord (@faccio.stefano).
Quentin Zanetaylor spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
